name: Anastasia Potapova
intro: Anastasia Potapova plays for Austria and lives in Vienna. She was born in Russia. She swings at the ball with all her might.
story: At 15, Anastasia won the junior title at Wimbledon. She became the No. 1 junior in the world. As a pro she has won three titles. This year she got into a big Madrid event as a lucky loser. Then she surprised everyone by reaching the semifinals!

funFacts.text: She travels to tournaments with her dog. She says the dog brings her luck.
She loves fashion, especially fancy handbags.
She tells stories with sound effects, like 'Woosh!' and 'Boom!'
Her grandmother coaches a basketball team in Moscow. She got Anastasia into tennis at age four.
She won Wimbledon's junior girls' title in 2016.
She says Austria feels like home. Starting in 2026 she plays for Austria.
She won a title in Linz, Austria, in 2023.

watchFor: Watch her giant swings. She winds up big on every forehand. Then she hits it super hard.

notes: Birth 2001-03-30 Saratov, resides Vienna, Austrian since Dec 2025/2026 season, R-handed/2HBH, 175 cm, 2016 Wimbledon girls' title at 15, junior No. 1, three WTA titles (Istanbul 2022, Linz 2023, Cluj 2025), first lucky loser to reach a WTA 1000 SF (Madrid 2026): confirmed on Wikipedia.
